title: Newmark Hires Sarah Miller as Valuation & Advisory National Co-Lead of Seniors Housing Practice
summary: Newmark announces that Sarah Miller, MAI, has joined the firm as Executive Vice President and National Co-Lead of Seniors Housing within its Valuation & Advisory practice.
